runs.title: Brightline's sample charger, cord cut
runs.about: Public-domain photos of one charger, before and after its cord was cut (Dmitry G, Wikimedia Commons). Sample recall; fictional.
runs.expect: Verified, then the refund goes out
runs.settings: Brightline Home's sample recall BH-2026-01, refund $34.99, auto-approve cap $50.00. One live Claude Opus 5.5 run recorded 2026-11-08 ($0.1158), replayed here.

summary.technical: Verified by two agreeing reviewers over soft items (C1 unclear). firm amount 34.99; no linked capture; refund 34.99 USD (firm, the lower); auto cap 50.00 USD. Reviewers: Product reviewer: meets, confidence 0.75; evidence: [right_product] Black charger housing with rounded end caps, opened and lying on its side, matching the shape of the recalled charger body (right side of the photo); [right_product] Black ribbed cord strain relief like the one where the cord meets the charger in official image 2, now pulled out of the housing (left center, held between the fingers); [right_product] Black fixed power cord running from the charger toward a barrel style DC plug (center of the photo, plug near top center); [made_safe] Cord cut at the strain relief with a white insulated wire and two bare stranded wires exposed (center left, sticking out to the right of the strain relief); [made_safe] Yellow insulating sheets removed from inside the housing, one with holes cut in it (top center and top right); [own_photo] Owner's thumb and finger in the foreground, shallow focus with the background blurred, real shadows and a seam line on the white surface (left edge foreground and across the background) | Remedy reviewer: meets, confidence 0.7; evidence: [made_safe] Black power cord end with its molded strain relief collar, with bare stranded metal wires and a white insulated wire sticking out, showing the cord has been severed at the collar where it joined the case (left center, held between the fingers); [made_safe] The separated cord runs loose across the table with no charger body attached to this end (center and bottom of the photo, looping cable); [right_product] Black charger housing, opened, lying on the table near the cut cord (right side of the photo); [right_product] Yellow and black insulating pieces from inside the charger case (top center and top right)
